The 5 spinal tracts: watch each pathway

Dorsal = posterior (top of the section), ventral = anterior. Click a coloured tract on the cross-section and its pathway plays on the right. Each tract has its own colour. Grey tracts are not among the 5 lecture tracts. Pick a cord syndrome to light up the tracts it knocks out.
